t: The Computer Port allows you to connect your Reactor to a computer for complex automation tasks.$(br2)A standard set of methods is exposed to the connected computer, and you can use them to query the status of the Reactor and control its behavior.
计算机端口可以让你将反应堆连接到计算机上，以执行复杂的自动化任务。$(br2)连接的计算机会获得一组标准方法，你可以用它们来查询反应堆状态并控制其行为。
To use the Computer Port, you need an external mod that adds programmable computers to the game.$(br2)Currently, the only such mod supported (and available) is CC.
要使用计算机端口，你需要安装一个能为游戏添加可编程计算机的外部模组。$(br2)目前唯一受支持（且可用）的这类模组是 CC。
